proof_0241.moves: An instance derivation: given the packaged hypothesis that a morphism property admits the small object argument at a regular cardinal, the category has pushouts. The entire proof is handing off to the corresponding field/lemma of that hypothesis; the cardinal and lattice apparatus in the statement is never touched.

proof_0242.moves: Pushing bitvector complement through a boolean `cond`: split on the boolean, and in each branch both sides are the same term. The real content is the case split on the Bool plus reflexivity; everything else is decide/simp residue.

proof_0243.moves: Graph distance is the `ENat.toNat` of the extended distance, so unfold `dist` to that form and transport the already-proved symmetry of `edist` through `toNat` by congruence.

proof_0244.moves: Density of a composite with an equivalence: build the `IsDense` structure objectwise, and at each object transport density along the comparison functor on costructured arrows, which is final because the precomposed functor is an equivalence.

proof_0245.moves: Rewrite the right shift as division by a power of two, then it is exactly the fact that natural division never increases a number.

proof_0246.moves: An unfolding lemma for the two-step list recursor on a two-element-prefix list: it is exactly the auto-generated third equation of the recursion. No mathematical idea beyond stating the defining equation.

proof_0247.moves: A definitional-unfolding lemma: the fundamental-sequence predicate at the `Sum.inl none` branch reduces by `Iff.rfl` to whatever that branch of the definition says. The content is purely that the two sides are definitionally equal.

proof_0248.moves: A `rfl` simp-lemma: the underlying map of the order isomorphism `mapAddSubgroup` induced by an additive equivalence is by construction the pushforward of subgroups, so the coercion computes definitionally.

proof_0249.moves: A `rfl` application lemma: the linear equivalence `congrRight₂` acts on a bilinear map exactly as its definition says, so both sides are definitionally equal. All the algebraic structure in the statement is inert typeclass scaffolding.

proof_0250.moves: A definitional application lemma: the equivalence built from a colimit cocone sends a morphism out of the apex to the corresponding cocone map by construction, so it closes by reflexivity.

proof_0251.moves: An unfolding equation for the tree-map union operation: both sides reduce to the same term, closed by decide/simp reflexivity residue. No mathematical step at all.

proof_0252.moves: Multiset union is defined as `s - t + t` (equivalently via subtraction and addition), so filtering distributes over union by combining the already-known distribution of filter over addition and over subtraction.

proof_0253.moves: The primed horizontal composite of two squares differs from the unprimed one only by whiskering with isomorphisms, and Guitart exactness is invariant under horizontal whiskering; so rewrite through that invariance and apply the unprimed composition theorem.

proof_0254.moves: The inclusion of finite types into Type creates finite colimits, and Type has all finite colimits; a functor that creates colimits of a shape whose colimits exist downstream preserves them. Assemble via the PreservesFiniteColimits constructor over all finite shapes.

proof_0255.moves: Subalgebras are determined by their underlying sets, so reduce to sets by coe-injectivity; then the image of an intersection under an injective map is the intersection of images.

proof_0256.moves: The multiplicative indicator of a monotone union is a special case of the piecewise-eventual-equality statement for monotone families; the proof just specializes that lemma (indicator being piecewise against the constant one).

proof_0257.moves: Derive the Ioc-flavoured Tendsto-Ixx instance from the Icc one using that half-open intervals sit inside closed intervals: apply the monotonicity-in-the-interval-family lemma with that inclusion.

proof_0258.moves: `generateFrom` is the left adjoint of a Galois connection with the open-sets map (in the order-dual of topologies), and a left adjoint sends suprema to suprema; apply that with the generateFrom Galois connection.

proof_0259.moves: A `rfl` lemma stating that the generic `Insert` instance for extensional hash sets is the namespaced insert function; the content is exactly the definitional identification of the instance with the function.

proof_0260.moves: An auto-generated field obligation of a CompleteLattice instance: the greatest-lower-bound property of the infimum, discharged directly by the already-established CompleteSemilatticeInf structure on saturated submonoids.

proof_0261.moves: Closure of a union of sets: closure is the left adjoint in a Galois insertion with the underlying-set map, and left adjoints preserve suprema, so the closure of a sUnion is the supremum of the closures.

proof_0262.moves: The weighted vector subtraction is defined as the base-point version at a fixed point, so restricting to the subset where weights are nonzero is exactly the already-proved statement for weightedVSubOfPoint; the proof is a direct specialization.

proof_0263.moves: Merge sort of the empty list is the empty list: unfold the first defining equation of mergeSort and close by reflexivity. Pure unfolding.

proof_0264.moves: The integer scalar action on a ring coming from its IntModule structure is multiplication by the integer cast; rewrite with the ring's zsmul-equals-intCast-times lemma and close by reflexivity.
